title: Kandil Making Activity
summary: As part of the ongoing Skills Development Project jointly undertaken by the RCMIC and AIILSG, students participated in a Best Out of Waste.
description:
As part of the ongoing Skills Development Project jointly undertaken by the RCMIC and AIILSG, students participated in a Best Out of Waste.
The students creatively crafted decorative Kandils (lanterns) using waste and reusable materials, promoting creativity, practical skills, and environmental awareness. The activity encouraged them to transform discarded materials into beautiful decorative items while understanding the principles of Reduce, Reuse, and Recycle (3Rs) and the importance of sustainable living.
